1070020001.name: Misty Lakeview
1070020001.description: The early fog softens dawn's first light. At the center of the stage, a maiden dances with the swans. Such tireless beauty.

1070020002.name: Golden Bloom
1070020002.description: As the buds bloom, splashes of gold dazzle the branches. It's the most brilliant color of spring.

1070020003.name: Butterfly's Pursuit
1070020003.description: A butterfly rests in the eye of the storm in a valley far away, searching for yesterday's dream.

1070020005.name: Let's go! Nikki and Momo!
1070020005.description: The horn of departure rings out, Nikki and Momo stand side by side, eyes glittering with curiosity and longing for the unknown world.

1070020006.name: Aqua Dreams
1070020006.description: The waves kiss the surface of the sea, as ripple after ripple flows languidly, creating layer upon layer of undulating patterns.

1070020007.name: Luminous Veil
1070020007.description: Snowflakes fall, weaving a glittering net, covering every corner of the earth.

1070020008.name: Blossoming Tales
1070020008.description: Flowers bloom in the garden where the morning sun peeks through and sprites weave fairy tales of courage and love.

1070020009.name: Lucky Key
1070020009.description: The lucky key, kissed by starlight, hangs silently in a sky of dreams, awaiting the guidance of a shooting star.

1070020010.name: Paper Crane's Mission
1070020010.description: Guided by the wind, paper cranes fly with the dreams of those who make them. They travel through the sky, land and flourish.

1070020011.name: Fleeting Fireworks
1070020011.description: The Isles were illuminated by dazzling fireworks as night fell. The lingering sparks drifted with the wind, leaving an imprint in everyone's eyes.

1070020012.name: Midnight Flames
1070020012.description: The fireworks draped the monotonous night in wonderful colors, as if putting on an elaborate and gorgeous show to kick off an all-night-long revelry.

1070020013.name: Laughing Bear Confetti
1070020013.description: Even with nothing but cotton on the inside, the little bear understands the meaning of happiness. "Wouldn't it be nice if everyone could laugh and be happy?" It thinks to itself as it spreads confetti to the earth with joy.

1070020014.name: Faded Moon
1070020014.description: The solitary moon fades into the corner of the night, unwilling to revisit the sorrowful past. In silence, it gazes upon the distant crumbling ruins, untouched by time's heavy toll.

1070020015.name: Ethereal Melody
1070020015.description: The endless melody gently drifts in, blending with the vast night, softly singing the tune of a destiny still unfolding.

1070020016.name: Swaying Wishes
1070020016.description: Faewish Sprites sway and dance gracefully beneath the soft starlight, with the dazzling stars as their perfect, in-sync partners.

1070020017.name: Feast of Illusions
1070020017.description: At the crossroads of light and dreams, lighthearted dance flows into the joyful overture, as the feast of fantasy never ends.

1070020018.name: Bubble Shadows
1070020018.description: With countless bubbles around, every step feels light and carefree!

1070020019.name: Snow Song Prayers
1070020019.description: Snowflakes flutter gently, a prayer for the cold night that lingers, while the celestial sky hums a soothing lullaby.

1070020020.name: Eternal Flame Heart
1070020020.description: A featherless bird repeatedly charges toward the blazing flames, its flapping echoing the hope held deep within its soul.

1070020021.name: Tapestry of Innocence
1070020021.description: The towering Stonetrees are adorned with Floragale cloth, dyed in delicate hues, while soft breezes and blooming flowers quietly guard every trace of innocence.

1070020022.name: Fairytale Dream
1070020022.description: Follow the fairy's traces and drift into a dazzling dream called 'Fairytale,' where reality and fantasy entwine.

1070020023.name: End of Tears
1070020023.description: Follow the blue river upstream, until you reach that lonely place where only tears fall.

1070020024.name: Lone Scale's Heart
1070020024.description: Every trace of tears begins as a ripple, echoing from a soft heart reaching out with kindness to another.

1070020025.name: Danqing Scroll
1070020025.description: Sky and earth, a canvas wide. Mountains, rivers, colors glide.

1070020026.name: Fated Return
1070020026.description: A thousand years, one thought ignites. Love that lingers, endless nights.

1070020027.name: Dreams in Scarlet
1070020027.description: No more dreams to wander through, the brush follows the heart true.

1070020028.name: Inked Dreams
1070020028.description: Danqing's unseen thread draws hearts near, a timeless tale, forever clear.

1070020029.name: Symphony of Resonance
1070020029.description: High, low, magnificent, melancholy... every sound tells tales old and new, countless joys and sorrows merging into a musical epic.

1070020030.name: Unfinished Aria
1070020030.description: Melody created from immersing in the dream of the tour. Its prelude flutters like delicate feathers, lingering again and again in the empty theater. As for the latter part, no one knows when it will ever be performed.

1070020031.name: Detective Strike
1070020031.description: With meticulous logic, uncover the buried truth. When the mist descends, only wisdom can guide the way!

1070020032.name: Falling Flowers
1070020032.description: Oh, verses drenched by the storm, at last they bloom into flowers, reviving the glory of yesterday.

1070020033.name: Wishfield Companions
1070020033.description: A gentle breeze sweeps across Wishfield as the fiery competition stirs hearts eager to prove themselves. Fellow companions, stand side by side and strive together for your shared ideals!

1070020034.name: Candlelit Shadows
1070020034.description: Flickering light dances upon the candlesticks as mottled shadows drift between the columns. The dust that floats in the glow, whose memories did it once carry?

1070020035.name: Deconstruction of Illusion
1070020035.description: The world's myriad forms surge like the tides, while truth stands steadfast, a silent stone in the sea. When the seeker's gaze pierces through a thousand layers of illusion, the eternal stillness resounds with truth's answering echo.

1070020036.name: Legend of the Sky's Breath
1070020036.description: Mountains hum beneath the drifting stars, and rivers compose songs through the canyons. Time is an endless string, and heaven and earth are its resounding notes.

1070020037.name: Spire Light
1070020037.description: The wind drifts through the silent tower, as white doves lift lost wishes into the sky, scattering songs of freedom and love across the boundless heavens.

1070020038.name: Infinite Dreamscape
1070020038.description: The mirror cannot reflect a soul that has lost its light. Nameless gleams spin and fall through the slanting sunlight. The evening breeze turns the pages of an old book, and for a brief moment, the silent names within its story come to light.

1070020039.name: Earth's Vitality
1070020039.description: The soil murmurs among the roots, as the monsoon brushes past sleeping seeds. Time turns every breath of nature into an endless rhythm of dawn and dusk.

1070020040.name: Newlife Trail
1070020040.description: "Part ways with the shade of yesterday and walk down the branching paths. The leaves rustle in the wind. Listen, it's the sound of love."

1070020041.name: A Poem for You
1070020041.description: May this poem be full of beauty, meanings, and memories. May it endure and be with you always.

1070020042.name: Send-off in Leaves
1070020042.description: The forest sheds its old leaves. The earth dons its new outfit. Swallow the sorrow of parting and hurry onto the long journey ahead. It's time you learned to bear the pain of goodbyes.

1070020043.name: Auspicious Night
1070020043.description: Candlelight warms the gentle night; revelry lingers bright. Steeds and carriages glide in delight, lanterns glow with light, and fish-dragon dances bloom through the night.

1070020044.name: Illusory Reality
1070020044.description: Deep in the alleys, cooking smoke rises and fades; through songs of joy and sorrow come parting and return, again and again. Within the ebb and flow of mortal life, understanding slowly dawns: all things are illusion—yet never a dream.

1070020045.name: Mortal-Heart Jade
1070020045.description: Drawing the breath of mortal life into uncarved jade, its outward form is traced and its heart softly painted. In flowing chromatic light, the mortal world takes shape, countless lives mirrored in shifting hues. Carved at last into a split ring, jade and world answer one another's light, growing ever clearer, ever true.

1070020046.name: Cherished Night
1070020046.description: Ornate lanterns chase the moon, guiding starlit eyes, as the heart swells to flutes and drums, rising like the tide. Crimson clouds drift in languid grace, carved railings framing the exquisite night. Cherish this evening, and let not its tenderness slip away.

1070020047.name: Dreamweaver's Hope
1070020047.description: Bows tie the threads of time, while stardust writes the poetry of dreams. May the path of light always touch your true heart, revealing a thousand blooming wonders.

1070020048.name: Frosted Ice Crown
1070020048.description: A sparkling crown inlaid with berries, as if crafted from melting snow and sheer sweetness, releasing a gentle, lingering scent of love.

1070020049.name: Sweet Dream Nook
1070020049.description: Spira, like a candy wonderland, rests amid sweet mists, fleeting as a dream.

1070020050.name: Night Forest Slumber
1070020050.description: The ballad echoes in the dark night as eeriness shrouds the forest; woven truths and falsehoods stretch out a lingering dread. Perhaps the forest too is waiting for the moment truth comes knocking.

1070020051.name: Flaming Heart
1070020051.description: She turned her fury into a blazing fire; she ground her fangs with rebellion. She hunts until death, hunting the lies that blind the eternal night.

1070020052.name: Mistwood Night Talk
1070020052.description: Layers of mist conceal the moonlight, and savage thorns imprison the past. Who sings of falsehoods, and who roars in defiance, seeking the truth?

1070020053.name: Tide of Returning Souls
1070020053.description: Like the deep breath of the earth, the tides draw scattered souls into their embrace. At the end of the journey home, every farewell becomes the prelude to reunion.

1070020054.name: Souls in Bloom
1070020054.description: As souls return with the tide, the breeze brushes across the water, and all that lingers, unfinished or unspoken, blooms into a sea of flowers along the river of time.

1070020055.name: Guide of the Long Night
1070020055.description: The one who ferries countless souls has no road home of their own. Lights fade from their fingertips, leaving only an eternal reflection upon the river of souls.

1070020056.name: Slumber in Bloom
1070020056.description: Though the body has turned to bones, the soul blooms anew amid the jagged remains. This is not the final chapter of fading away, but a vow of unending life and quiet vigil.

1070020057.name: Lingering Tides
1070020057.description: Listen quietly to the Ferry Song and pick up pieces of forgotten memories. All those moments of joy and confusion will leave with the passing tides. Only the resolve to persevere remains unchanged.

1070020058.name: Rose Dream
1070020058.description: As she stepped into the shores of rebirth, her obsession dissipated along with crimson petals. She could finally let go of the pain and sink into a sweet dream that would never end.

1070020059.name: Echoes of the Lyre
1070020059.description: She once mused about another possibility, but no one can go back in time. To the sound of strings, she paused for brief moment, then heading toward rebirth without regret.

1070020060.name: Midsummer Soundwave
1070020060.description: The curtain rises, and the music of summer resounds through fireworks, transforming into surging waves of sound that instantly awaken the entire starry night sky.

1070020061.name: To This Very Moment
1070020061.description: Waves gather wishes, writing the poetry of travelers. May each layer of tide carry memories and preserve every radiant moment.

1070020062.name: Endless Ripples
1070020062.description: Gently dip your hand into the warm currents. With a slight movement of your fingertips, countless bubbles filled with heartfelt voices ripple into being in your palm.

1070020064.name: Turning Era
1070020064.description: Some creations were never bound by day or night from the moment they were born. Deep within the city, it rings on and on, turning without rest, forging an undying radiance of civilization through silent ages.

1070020065.name: Long Night's Dawn
1070020065.description: Even beneath an endless night, a heart set on flight never pauses. Its wings cut through every dark current, all to carry that first waking glimmer at the horizon and fly with all its strength toward the dawn it longs for.

1070020066.name: White Night Pirouette
1070020066.description: White night settles softly, its flowing radiance surging like a tide as she dances through a thousand shifting lights. Each step feels etched in time, becoming part of a dream from the past that never wished to end.

1070020067.name: Dawnlit Wish
1070020067.description: A glimmer is born from a wish, and devotion shines brighter through steadfast watchfulness. If no answer has yet come from afar, let this golden feather remember the path once lit by hope.

1070020068.name: Clear Sky and Far Lands
1070020068.description: Clear skies stretch into the distance, and the days of summer linger on. Let the footsteps follow the wind, singing the moods from the road, little by little, toward faraway lands.

1070020069.name: Wood-Cog Reverie
1070020069.description: Deep within the vines, gears slowly turn, and all things cycle through this silent rhythm. Flowers bloom along golden wheels, while the grass and trees follow the gentle beats, flourishing as ever.

1070020070.name: Floral Dreamwake
1070020070.description: If the heart is a garden, wishes awaken amidst the flowers. Drawn by their fragrance, the fairy arrived and left a gentle gift behind. Dreams and flowers grew together until the recipients finally saw their true hearts reflected in a long dream.

1070020071.name: Star Wish Journey
1070020071.description: He wrote his longing and his wishes into a letter and sent it off with a shooting star, hoping it would drift along the river of stars to the distant places he had never reached.

1070020072.name: Unfallen Gold
1070020072.description: The clamor of the Golden Hour slowly fades away. Deep in the flower courtyard, light pierces the heavy night and illuminates a forgotten treasure. And those secrets still wait quietly for someone to come.

1070020073.name: Golden Law Light
1070020073.description: The golden age has sunk into dust, leaving but a sliver of radiance to light the ancient murals. The golden feather sweeps across a millennial dusk, opening a judgment never yet set down.

1070020074.name: Blooming in Morning Light
1070020074.description: The Rose hides within the soil, adorning herself in the colors she loves. When the first ray of sunlight breaks the morning, she arrives right on time, radiant beyond compare.

1070020075.name: Snowy Wish
1070020075.description: Bury a wish beneath the winter snow, hoping that one day when the ice melts, the snow clears, and spring returns, it will sprout like a seed, sending forth a tender shoot of hope.

1070020076.name: Winter Night Wishes
1070020076.description: Though the winter nights may stretch on, remember that we once stood beneath the same starry sky. Come, let us gather by the warmth of this campfire and use this gift to preserve this moment we share.

1070020077.name: A Wish for Tomorrow
1070020077.description: Gather a little happiness, bind it with a ribbon of little wishes, and send it as a gift to your future self.
